# FOO 0.1.0

**Release type:** FOO

**Git tag:** `foo-v0.1.0`

FOO 0.1.0 is the first production release of the native FOO compiler, with project checking, building, running, testing, formatting, C11 and Zig output, and the standard library.

## Release Files

| Type | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows installer | `foo-v0.1.0-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Linux installer | `foo-v0.1.0-linux-x64.deb` |
| Windows archive | `foo-v0.1.0-windows-x64.zip` |
| Linux archive | `foo-v0.1.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| npm package | `foo-0.1.0.tgz` |
| Checksums | `SHA256SUMS.txt` |

For a guided installation, run the Windows installer or open the Linux installer in your system's software manager. Verify downloaded files against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
